title: Protocol for the use of signal amplification by exchange reaction-fluorescence in situ hybridization on adult formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded mouse lung tissue
protocol: Design probes (Day - 5–7)
Timing: hands on time - 2–3 h
Obtain reference sequence for gene of interest from NCBI.
Type your gene of interest into the search bar for NCBI. For example, FGF10.
Change the ortholog to “mouse.”
Scroll down to the “NCBI Reference Sequences” and select the mRNA sequence.
Select the appropriate mRNA sequence (e.g., NP_008002.5).
Click “send to” and select “coding sequences” or “complete record” and download the FASTA nucleotide file.
Note: The untranslated regions can be included if the gene of interest has fewer than 20 probes within the exon regions.
Note: Introns can also be included to analyze splicing.
Design a 9nt primer sequence for each RNA target.
Create a hairpin structure for extending the designed 9nt primer on the probe.
Design three branches for signal amplification, ensuring each includes reverse complements and termination sequences as specified.
For each branch, design a corresponding hairpin extension structure similar to the probe's hairpin.
Design fluorescent probes with sequences complementary to the last added branch for signal amplification.
Resuspend probes at 100 μM in nuclease-free water.
Allow probes to dissolve for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Mix probes from a single RNA target with equal amounts of each probe.
Create 18mM solutions of dATP, dTTP, and dCTP.
Combine equal amounts of diluted (18mM) dATP, dTTP, and dCTP to make each solution 6mM.
Prepare buffers according to the sample adaptation using a 10x Visium cassette.
Wipe microtome, water bath, and tools for sectioning with RNase-Zap wipes.
Load microtome with a fresh cutting blade.
Put fresh RNase/DNase-free water in the waterbath.
Set water bath temperature to 42°C and allow it to reach temperature.
Outline wells on the back of slides if using a 10x Visium cassette.
Section and discard the first 2–3 5um sections from the first tissue block.
Move the blade to a fresh area and cut 5um sections for FISH.
Place the section in waterbath and allow it to melt slightly.
Smooth wrinkles on the section.
Place the section on the slide (in the topmost square if using 10x Visium cassette).
Repeat for each tissue block. Each section should be placed into a separate square.
Place finished slides in a 37°C humidified slide dryer for 16–24 h.
Prepare a thermal cycler program with the following program and begin the program.
Mix the reagents for probe PER and branch PER in PCR tubes on ice. Each probe and branch require separate tubes.
Place PCR tube in the thermal cycler and skip the “37°C forever.”
After 15 min, add 5 μL of the probe mix or 10 μL of the branch to the appropriate PCR tube.
Allow the program to finish.
Make a 1.25% agarose gel and add 1 μL of SYBR Gold per 10 mL of agarose.
Add DNA ladder, probe pool/branch pool (5–10 μL with 1–2 μL of 6x loading buffer), and each PER (10 μL with 2 μL of 6x loading buffer) to the gel.
Run the gel at 150V for 15 min.
Image the gel.
Run the gel again at 150V for 15 more minutes.
Image the gel.
Purify 5 μg of PER using Qiagen MinElute PCR Purification Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Store purified PER at −20°C until ready for use.
Remove slide(s) from 37°C humidified slide drying and place at 60°C for 2 h.
Allow the slide to cool to room temperature.
Deparaffinize by immersing slide in toluene twice, each for 10 min.
Replace toluene between each 10-min incubation.
Immerse slides in toluene for 10 minutes.
Cover tissues with toluene during immersion.
Place slides on a RNase-free Coplin jar.
Prepare thermal cycler to 37°C with Visium slide adapter.
Incubate slide in 100% ethanol twice for 3 minutes each, replacing ethanol between incubations.
Incubate slide on thermal cycler Visium adapter for 15 minutes at 37°C without closing the lid.
Incubate slide in 100% ethanol for 3 minutes.
Incubate slide in 96% ethanol twice for 3 minutes each, replacing ethanol between incubations.
Incubate slide in 70% ethanol for 3 minutes.
Incubate slide in RNase/DNase-free water for 20 seconds.
Let the slide air dry.
Insert the slide into the 10x Visium cassette without disturbing the tissues.
Add 150 μL of 1x TE buffer (pH 9.0) along the side of the cassette wells.
Remove all TE buffer from the wells carefully, ensuring not to disturb the tissues.
Add 100 μL of TE buffer (pH 9.0) along the side of the wells.
Seal the Visium cassette with a seal to prevent evaporation.
Incubate the slide at 70°C for 1 hour with the lid closed.
Remove the cassette and place it on a flat, clean surface.
Remove the seal from the cassette.
Remove all TE buffer from the wells.
Add 100 μL of 1x PBS for 5 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Remove the PBS and add 100 μL of pre-hybridization mix.
Incubate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 15 minutes.
Remove all pre-hybridization mix from the wells.
Add Primary probe mix to the wells.
Incubate at 43°C for 16 hours.
Remove slides from the thermal cycler and set the thermal cycler to 37°C.
Remove the seal and remove all the Primary probe mix, quickly replacing it with prewarmed (37°C) Wash buffer.
Wash the samples twice for 30 minutes at 37°C with Wash buffer.
Wash the samples twice with 2x SSC for 5 minutes each at 37°C.
Add the first branch mix to the slide, cover with a seal, and incubate at 37°C for 10 hours.
Remove the seal and discard the first branch mix.
Replace it quickly with prewarmed (37°C) Wash buffer.
Discard the Wash buffer and wash twice for 30 min at 37°C with Wash buffer.
Wash the samples twice with 2x SSC for 5 min each at 37°C.
Add the second branch mix to the slide, cover with a seal, and incubate at 37°C for 10 h.
Remove the seal and discard the second branch mix.
Replace it quickly with prewarmed (37°C) Wash buffer.
Discard the Wash buffer and wash twice for 30 min at 37°C with Wash buffer.
Wash the samples twice with 2x SSC for 5 min each at 37°C.
Wash the samples twice with Antibody wash buffer for 5 min each at 37°C.
Add the fluorescent probe mix to the slide, cover with a seal, and incubate at 37°C for 1.5 h.
Discard the fluorescent probe mix from the slides.
Wash slides twice with 0.1% Tween-20 in PBS for 5 min each.
Remove the slides from the cassette.
Slide from the cassette without disrupting the tissue.
Mount slides for imaging using mounting media and coverslip, then place on microscope.
Incubate slides in PBS to naturally remove the coverslip; do not force it off.
Circle the tissue with PAP pen.
Incubate samples with 50 μL blocking buffer for a minimum of 30 min at room temperature.
Incubate with antibodies for 16–24 hours at 4°C.
Remove slides from 4°C and tap off the primary antibody solution.
Wash the sample three times with 50 μL of Antibody wash solution for 5 minutes each.
Dilute fluorescent secondary antibodies in staining buffer.
Tap off the last wash and replace with fluorescent antibody solution.
Incubate for 3 hours at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Wash the sample three times with 50 μL of Antibody wash solution for 5 minutes each.
Tap off the last wash and mount the slide with mounting media and a coverslip.
Proceed immediately to imaging.
